about:
Alabama Gulf Coast Wood Designs operates from Mobile, Alabama, as a sole proprietorship specializing in custom carpentry and woodworking. The founding year and owner's name are not publicly disclosed.

The business provides a range of woodworking services including kitchen fittings, joinery, furniture repair and reassembly, wood wall panelling, and custom windows and doors. It also produces handmade furniture such as tables, benches, chairs, beds, and shelves. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

The company serves residential and commercial clients in the Mobile area, addressing needs for living spaces and business offices. Concrete examples include custom door installations for security and style, and bespoke furniture pieces for homeowners.

The proprietor emphasizes custom design as the core of the business, citing a fusion of passion and years of experience as the basis for handling ambitious projects. The business also offers 24/7 availability and free consultations.
